name: Career Crox – Calling Assistant
tagline: Recruitment Automation Companion for high-volume professionals using Career Crox CRM.
description:
Transform your recruitment workflow with automated dialing, real-time CRM synchronization, and intelligent performance tracking. The ultimate mobile companion for recruitment professionals using Career Crox CRM.

Built with Kotlin, Android Architecture Components, Retrofit2, OkHttp3, and Hilt Dependency Injection.

Core Capabilities:
- Smart Automated Dialing Queue: Configurable auto-dialer with 10-second preparation countdowns between candidate calls, supporting remote pause/resume via desktop CRM.
- Real-Time Candidate CRM Sync: Instant candidate list hydration and post-call status synchronization (Dialed, Connected, Not Connected, Call Back).
- Live Performance Metrics & AHT Analytics: Calculates Average Handling Time (AHT) and tracks recruiter productivity benchmarks in real time.
- Resume & Call Audio Attachment: Upload candidate resumes (PDF, DOCX, images) directly from mobile to candidate profiles and attach call audio logs for interview audits.
- WhatsApp One-Tap Messaging: Initiate WhatsApp conversations with candidates instantly without saving temporary phone numbers to the device.
- Secure 6-Digit Code Pairing: Authenticate mobile devices securely with Career Crox CRM using session tokens and remote logout support.
